title: BLOOM Public Release
summary: The BigScience collaboration publicly released BLOOM on July 12, 2022, describing it as a 176-billion-parameter multilingual language model capable of generating text in 46 natural languages and 13 programming languages.
significance: A documented public-release milestone for a large multilingual language model developed through the international BigScience research collaboration.

verification.note: The BigScience/Hugging Face release post is dated July 12, 2022 and explicitly says 'Today, we release BLOOM,' while describing the 176B-parameter model and its 46 natural-language and 13 programming-language coverage. The later BLOOM paper independently documents the model as a 176B-parameter open-access multilingual language model and states that the models and code were publicly released. No development geography, ancestry, influence, causality or relationships are inferred.
